name: gatt-smoke
description: BLE GATT TRANSACTION-shape pilot over the SHIPPED client: the VIRTUAL leg (--backend virtual) drives the GattServer model through the generic _serve_op path. Proves one semantic op == one client-observable result: enum lists the pinned characteristic table; fw_version is the always-readable banner-analogue; the static permission errors render as ATT 0x02 (read of the write-only unlock) and 0x03 (write of the read-only fw_version) with a nonzero exit; the secret reads the LOCKED sentinel (00000000) until a CORRECT-key unlock write flips it to the staged value, and a WRONG-key write neither errors nor unlocks (retry-with-the-right-key). The unlock key is course-FIXED (01020304), so it is in diff scope. Values <= 20 bytes (single-characteristic scope: no Read Blob, no notifications, no SMP). ATT errors are rendered to stderr (asserted via `expect_stderr`); values/acks to stdout (`expect`). `exit` pins each step's expected exit code. The real AX201<->ESP32 diff is a gated spot-check (no software BLE loopback); this virtual leg is the CI gate.
